name: Embracing the Elements
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident Shaman trainer--Windshaper Boro--left this recall crystal for you. Please examine it, then speak with Boro just over yonder near the center of the village.
narrative.objectives: Examine the Humming Recall Crystal then speak with Windshaper Boro in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: Can you hear it? The whispers of the winds? Doubtful, considering that the spirits stopped speaking with us when they left us those years ago.Those among us who would seek audience with the spirits of the four winds once more hone our understanding of the elements and the natural world, dearly hoping to reestablish the dialogue that was so abruptly ended.Would you walk this path and master the elements?Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps and I will train you.
